Featured Applications and Solutions # PET Bottle Recycling and Washing Line # PET Bottle Recycling and Washing Line
PET (polyethylene terephthalate) bottles are widely used in packaging for beverages, food, and daily chemicals. ACERETECH’s PET bottle recycling and washing lines are designed to efficiently process and clean used PET bottles, enabling their reuse in new products and reducing environmental impact.
Efficient Shredding of PET Lumps and Straps # Efficient Solution for Shredding PET Lumps Straps: ACERETECH Double Shaft Shredder
Handling tough PET materials, such as lumps and straps, requires robust shredding solutions. The ACERETECH Double Shaft Shredder offers high efficiency and reliability, making it suitable for demanding recycling operations.
PE Agricultural Film Recycling and Washing # PE Agricultural Film Recycling and Washing Line
PE (polyethylene) agricultural films are essential in modern agriculture but pose environmental challenges when discarded. ACERETECH’s recycling and washing lines for PE films help recover valuable materials and minimize waste.
PA Plastic Fiber Recycling and Pelletizing # PA Plastic Fiber Recycling and Pelletizing
With growing environmental awareness, the recycling and pelletizing of PA (polyamide) plastic fibers have gained attention. ACERETECH’s technology supports the circular economy by enabling efficient processing of these fibers.
PET Bottle Flake Granulation # Professional Solution for Recycling and Granulation of PET Bottle Flakes: ACERETECH ASE Single Screw Granulator
The ASE Single Screw Granulator is designed for the recycling and granulation of PET bottle flakes, providing a professional solution for transforming waste into high-quality pellets.
PET Bottle Flake Label Separation # PET Bottle Flake Label Separator
Labels on PET bottle flakes can hinder the recycling process. ACERETECH’s label separator addresses this challenge, improving the purity and value of recycled PET materials.
EPS Foam Recycling and Pelletizing # EPS Foam Recycling and Pelletizing
EPS (expandable polystyrene) foam is lightweight and versatile but often difficult to recycle. ACERETECH offers solutions for recycling and pelletizing EPS foam, supporting its reuse in various applications.
LDPE Film Waste Shredding and Pelletizing # Best Solution for Post Industrial Compined LDPE Film Waste–ASP 2 in 1 Shredding and Pelletizing Line
Post-industrial LDPE (low-density polyethylene) film waste can be efficiently recycled using the ASP 2-in-1 shredding and pelletizing line, enabling in-house recycling and resource recovery.
PP Plastic Recycling Granulation # PP Plastic Recycling Granulation
Polypropylene (PP) is a widely used plastic. ACERETECH’s granulation technology supports the recycling of PP waste, contributing to resource conservation and environmental protection.
PE Pipe Recycling and Washing # PE Pipe Recycling and Washing Line
PE pipes are common in water supply, drainage, and agriculture. ACERETECH’s recycling and washing lines help recover and reuse PE pipe materials.
HDPE Bottle Recycling and Washing # HDPE Bottle Recycling and Washing Line
HDPE (high-density polyethylene) bottles are prevalent in packaging. ACERETECH’s solutions enable efficient recycling and washing of HDPE bottles for further use.
PP PE Calcium Carbonate Modified Pelletizing # PP PE Calcium Carbonate Modified Recycling Pelletizing
The addition of calcium carbonate to PP and PE materials enhances their properties. ACERETECH’s modified pelletizing technology supports the production of high-performance recycled plastics.

The Role of Plastic Shredders and Crushers in Modern Recycling # Plastic waste is a growing global concern, with discarded products often ending up as non-biodegradable trash. Addressing this challenge requires effective solutions for processing and recycling plastic materials. Plastic shredders and crushers are essential tools in this effort, enabling the transformation of bulky plastic waste into manageable, recyclable fractions.
Why Invest in Plastic Shredding Technology? # Plastic shredding machines offer an eco-friendly approach to recycling by breaking down various types of plastics, including thermoplastics like PE, PP, PVC, PS, PU, and PET, as well as thermosets and elastomers. These machines are engineered with customizable rotor designs and specialized cutting tools, allowing them to efficiently process a wide range of plastic materials. The resulting smaller plastic pieces can then be granulated and reused, supporting closed-loop recycling and reducing the environmental impact of plastic products.
Shredders are particularly valuable for their ability to handle bulky waste, streamlining the size reduction process and facilitating remanufacturing. By integrating shredders into recycling operations, organizations can contribute to sustainable recovery and reprocessing, helping to mitigate plastic pollution.
Product Range: Shredders, Crushers, and Pulverizers # ACERETECH offers a diverse selection of shredders and crushers, each designed to address specific recycling needs. Below is an overview of available models:
GE Plastic Recycling Shredder Machine For Waste Management GF Series High Output Efficient Plastic Crusher Machine GH Heavy-Duty Plastic Crushers Grinding Machine GP Series Plastic Crusher Machine For Grinding Long Plastic Pipes HS Series Single Shaft Hard Plastic Shredder LS Series Plastic Waste Single Shaft Shredder With Small Volume And Wall Thickness MS Series Adjustable PP PVC PE HDPE Pipe Waste Industail Plastic Shredder PS Series Single Shaft Plastic Shredder For Pipe Recycling XS Series Heavy Single-Shaft Shredder PM300 Plastic Recycling Pulverizer Machine with European Appliances PM500 PVC Pulverizer Machine for Plastic Recycling PM800 Carbon Steel Pulverizer Machine for Plastic Reuse How Plastic Shredders Support Recycling Operations # Plastic shredders, also known as crushers or granulators, are integral to recycling plants and production facilities. They break down plastic waste into smaller pieces, making it easier to process and reuse as raw materials or finished products in various industries. The machines are available in multiple models and configurations, tailored to the type and size of plastic waste being processed. Internal mechanisms can be designed for horizontal, vertical, or rotational movement, with adjustable speeds and torque to suit specific requirements.
Custom solutions are highly valued in the recycling industry, as they enable efficient size reduction and material recovery. Continuous innovation and engineering improvements help optimize recycling operations, ensuring economical and effective reprocessing of plastic waste.
Advantages of ACERETECH Shredders and Crushers # ACERETECH specializes in engineering shredders and crushers that address the unique challenges of plastic recycling across diverse industries. Key features include:
Heavy-duty construction for reliable operation in demanding environments Innovative designs that maximize shredding productivity and efficiency Flexible customization to handle various plastic types and volumes Intelligent engineering for straightforward operation and maintenance These shredders are designed to reduce plastic waste to optimal sizes for post-processing, supporting a wide range of recycling applications. ACERETECH offers tailored solutions, from granulators to scrap shredders, to meet specific operational needs.
Considerations for Selecting a Shredder # To ensure the best fit for your recycling requirements, consider the following:
Types of waste materials to be processed Size of items to be fed into the shredder Required processing speed per hour Desired final product size after shredding For more information or to discuss your specific needs, contact the ACERETECH team.

content:
Integrated Solutions for Plastic Recycling Pelletizing # The recycling of plastic materials is a critical step toward sustainability and resource efficiency. At Aceretech, we offer a comprehensive range of recycling pelletizing systems designed to transform plastic waste into high-quality pellets suitable for various manufacturing applications.
Product Range: Recycling Pelletizing Systems # Our recycling pelletizing systems are engineered to provide a one-step, efficient, and sustainable solution for processing a wide variety of plastic materials. The resulting pellets can be directly used in blown film, pipe extrusion, and injection molding, eliminating the need for additional processing and helping manufacturers optimize both time and cost.
ACS-H Single Screw Cutter Compactor Plastic Recycling Pelletizing Machine ACS-PRO Excellent Degassing and Filtering Plastic Recycling Pelletizing Line ACSS Double Stage Plastic Cutter Compactor Recycling Pelletizing Line ADS Double Stage Rigid Plastic Recycling Pelletizing Line with Single Screw ASE Single Screw Extruder Rigid Plastic Recycling Pelletizing Machine ASP Single Screw Shredding and Pelletizing Extrusion Line for In-plant Recycling ATE Parallel Twin Screw Recycling Pelletizing Extruder For Plastic Modification What is a Cutter Compactor Recycling Pelletizing Line? # A cutter compactor recycling pelletizing line is an integrated system that combines crushing, compacting, plasticizing, and pelletizing in a single process. This technology is suitable for recycling and pelletizing a variety of plastic materials, including film, raffias, filaments, bags, woven bags, and foaming materials.
How the System Works # The process begins with the crushing of plastic waste into small flakes. These flakes are then compacted and heated in the compactor section, which melts the plastic and removes impurities. The molten plastic is subsequently fed into the pelletizer, where it is cut into uniform pellets. These pellets are ready for direct use in blown film, tube extrusion, and injection molding production.
Unlike traditional shredders, the cutter compactor utilizes a rotating chamber with stationary and rotary blades to cut and compact various types of plastic waste. It also preheats and dries the material, facilitating easier feeding into the extruder. This approach is particularly effective for low to medium-volume production with simple shapes and loose tolerances.
Key Benefits # One-step smart recycling: Integrates crushing, compacting, plasticizing, and granulating, streamlining the recycling process. Versatile material handling: Capable of processing film, raffia, filament, bags, woven bags, and foam materials. High-quality output: Produces pellets suitable for a wide range of plastic processing applications. Environmental impact: Supports efforts to reduce plastic pollution by converting waste into reusable pellets. Applications of Pelletized Products # Blown film production Tube extrusion Injection molding Other plastic processing applications Integrated Plastic Recycling System Advantages # Aceretech’s plastic granulating lines feature a cutter compactor (agglomerator) on the main extruder, setting them apart from conventional granulation machines. This design results in a more compact and efficient system, where material is pre-heated, cut, mixed, and fed into the extruder as granules. The extruder is equipped with a degassing system and a hydraulic screen changer to ensure the production of high-purity pellets.
Our systems are aligned with Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing trends, utilizing intelligent PLC control systems with user-friendly HMI interfaces to enhance automation. Digital program logic technology and ECO inverter modules enable fully automatic pelletizing, meeting the growing demand for efficient recycling. Innovative pneumatic constant pressure control technology further stabilizes the pelletizing process.
The cutter compactor incorporates unique reverse feeding technology and a baffle structure, improving the feeding and recycling efficiency of filament fiber. By recycling plastic waste through a compaction granulator and converting it into high-quality pellets, we contribute to reducing the environmental impact of plastic waste.
For more information or expert guidance on selecting the right plastic recycling machines, please contact the Aceretech team.
